# `aitbc exchange-island orders`

List exchange orders, optionally filtered by user, status, or pair.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange-island orders [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--user` | text | — | no | Filter by user ID |
| `--status` | text | — | no | Filter by status (open, filled, partially_filled, cancelled) |
| `--pair` | choice | — | no | Filter by trading pair |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange-island orders
```
